## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, linting, and type checks pass
- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass
- [ ] Production build passes
- [ ] Browser behavior was checked when the UI changed
- [ ] API contract and generated files are current when applicable

## Quality and risk

- [ ] No secrets, private notes, or production data are included
- [ ] Privacy, CSP, origin, input/output validation, and safe logging remain intact
- [ ] Keyboard, reduced-motion, fallback, and responsive behavior remain intact
- [ ] Deployment and rollback impact is documented
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings are attached for visual changes

## Notes for reviewers

Call out tradeoffs, known limitations, follow-up work, or areas needing special
attention. Do not use this section to hide incomplete required work.
